title: Milito 2010: three finals, four goals, not even on the list
checked: Milito joined Inter from Genoa in summer 2009; 30 goals in all competitions, 22 in Serie A (Wikipedia, Inter.it). Coppa Italia final 5 May 2010, Stadio Olimpico, Inter 1-0 Roma, Milito the only goal (Wikipedia final, Inter.it). Siena 0-1 Inter, 16 May 2010, Milito 57' from Zanetti, title won; final table Inter 82, Roma 80 (Wikipedia Serie A 2009-10, Fox/AP, Inter.it). CL final 22 May 2010, Bernabeu, Bayern 0-2 Inter, Milito 35' (Sneijder) and 70' (Eto'o, turned Van Buyten), first European Cup since 1965, first Italian treble (Wikipedia, Eurosport, Inter.it). 5 to 22 May = 17 days. UEFA Club Footballer and Club Forward of the Year 2010, ahead of Messi (UEFA, MaltaToday). Left off FIFA's 23-man Ballon d'Or list, four Inter players on it, Moratti called it 'an incredible decision' (SI, MaltaToday). 2010 result: Messi 22.65%, Iniesta 17.36%, Xavi 16.48%, Sneijder 4th 14.48% (Wikipedia, FC Barcelona). Gameplay: both final goals recreated with gamecap (specs/rob-milito-2010.json); Inter's stripes show as one blue on the figures.

lines.text: Three finals in seventeen days. Four goals. Three trophies. And the Ballon d'Or didn't even list him.
lines.say: Three finals in seventeen days. Four goals. Three trophies. And the Balon Dor didn't even list him.

lines.text: Summer 2009. José Mourinho's Inter buy a thirty-year-old striker from Genoa.
lines.say: Summer two thousand and nine. Hozay Moreenyo's Inter buy a thirty year old striker from Jennoa.

scene.headline: Inter sign Diego Milito from Genoa
scene.standfirst: Mourinho gets his centre-forward. Nobody outside Italy has heard much of him. That is about to change.

lines.text: He scores thirty that season. Then come three finals.
lines.say: He scores thirty that season. Then come three finals.

lines.text: Final one. The Coppa Italia against Roma, in Rome. One goal. His.
lines.say: Final one. The Koppa Itahleeya against Roma, in Rome. One goal. His.

lines.text: Final two. The last day of Serie A, away at Siena. Lose, and Roma take the title.
lines.say: Final two. The last day of Serie A, away at Seeyenna. Lose, and Roma take the title.

scene.headline: Win at Siena or lose the title
scene.standfirst: Inter go into the last day two points clear of Roma. Anything but a win could hand the Scudetto to Rome.

lines.text: Fifty-seven minutes. Zanetti slips him in. Milito. One-nil. Champions by two points.
lines.say: Fifty seven minutes. Zanettee slips him in. Meeleetoh. One nil. Champions by two points.

lines.text: Final three. Madrid. The Champions League final against Bayern.
lines.say: Final three. Madrid. The Champions League final against Byern.

lines.text: Thirty-five minutes. Sneijder slides it back, and Milito is through. One-nil.
lines.say: Thirty five minutes. Snyder slides it back, and Meeleetoh is through. One nil.

lines.text: Seventy minutes. Eto'o finds him again. He turns Van Buyten inside out. Two-nil.
lines.say: Seventy minutes. Ehtohoh finds him again. He turns Van Boyten inside out. Two nil.

lines.text: Inter's first European Cup in forty-five years. The first treble in Italian football.
lines.say: Inter's first European Cup in forty five years. The first treble in Italian football.

lines.text: In August, UEFA named him their Club Footballer of the Year. Ahead of Messi.
lines.say: In August, Yooayfuh named him their Club Footballer of the Year. Ahead of Messi.

lines.text: Then in October, FIFA named twenty-three players for the Ballon d'Or. Four from Inter. Not Milito.
lines.say: Then in October, FIFA named twenty three players for the Balon Dor. Four from Inter. Not Meeleetoh.

scene.headline: Milito left off the Ballon d'Or list
scene.standfirst: Sneijder, Eto'o, Maicon and Júlio César make FIFA's 23. The man who scored twice in the final does not.

lines.text: Inter's president, Massimo Moratti, rang him to say sorry.
lines.say: Inter's president, Massimo Morattee, rang him to say sorry.

lines.text: In January, the podium was Messi, Iniesta and Xavi. All Barcelona.
lines.say: In January, the podium was Messi, Inyestah and Shahvee. All Barcelona.

lines.text: Europe's best player. The treble. Both goals in the final. Not even on the list. That's the robbery.
lines.say: Europe's best player. The treble. Both goals in the final. Not even on the list. That's the robbery.
